text:
Alice M.: Kicking off this thread for Peregrine Systems RFP questions. They're asking for a hybrid POC (Redwood Dedicated + on-prem drop-in), HSM-backed key material, and evidence for SOC-like controls. Can we align on timeline, deliverables, and blockers?

Ben (Sales): Need to respond to procurement by EOW. They want a 4-week technical POC, pricing for dedicated reserved capacity + one-time on-prem setup, and an estimate vs self-hosting. Any minimum commit?

Clara - Solutions Eng: @Ben we can run a 4-week POC. Proposed schedule: week 0: onboarding/network prep; week 1: infra + HSM/KMS validation; week 2: model onboarding + perf tuning; week 3: scale tests + acceptance; week 4: handover and docs. Will need their network diagram and HSM vendor/model (PKCS#11).

Dave S.: Major enterprise ask: they require FIPS 140-2/3 validated HSM and customer-managed key material, plus audit log export to their S3. Also they insist on private control plane connectivity (VPN or VPC peering). How much drift from our standard on-prem bundle?

Clara - Solutions Eng: We already support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, GCP KMS) and PKCS#11 HSMs via our on-prem connector. Connector validation: estimate 3 business days for vendor compatibility check + 2–3 days integration testing. VPN/VPC peering adds ~1–2 days with networking team and customer.

Ben (Sales): Pricing question: can we offer a POC credit + a short-term discounted Dedicated rate for first 90 days? They want to show ~50% cost advantage over their current self-hosted stack. Any constraints?

Alice M.: We typically provide limited POC credits and a short-term promotional rate. Commercial needs: define usage caps for POC, and a clear rollback plan if they exceed. Send me proposed numbers and I'll run them past revenue ops.

DevEx Bot: Uploaded files to shared drive: /shared/sales/peregrine/capability-matrix-draft.xlsx (2.8MB), /shared/sales/peregrine/network-checklist.md, /shared/sales/peregrine/sample-statement-of-work.pdf

Clara - Solutions Eng: Paste of capability matrix snippet for procurement (quick view):

```
Feature | Redwood Supported | Notes
On-prem HSM (PKCS#11) | Yes | Connector validated for Thales/CloudHSM; need model
Customer-managed KMS | Yes | AWS, GCP, Azure; key rotation supported
Private control plane (VPC/VPN) | Yes | Requires peering/VPN config
SLA (Dedicated) | 99.9% | Subject to reserved capacity contract
P95 latency (8k ctx) | ~120ms token | depends on batch sizing
Data residency controls | Yes | Region pinned deployments
```

Clara - Solutions Eng: I'll export the full matrix into the spreadsheet and flag rows Peregrine called out. Need final perf numbers (p95/p99) for 8k and 32k scenarios from infra.

Ben (Sales): Legal wants confirmation on log retention and audit export: Peregrine requires 12 months retention and ability to push audit logs to their S3. Any compliance concerns?

Dave S.: We can set retention to 12 months; must size storage accordingly. For S3 export, we'll need an IAM role or presigned exports depending on Private vs Dedicated. Provide required policies and we'll coordinate with their infra team. No blockers otherwise.

Alice M.: Action items: 1) Clara: finalize capability matrix + HSM integration steps by Tue EOD. 2) Clara/Dave: draft KMS/HSM security note including required configs for customer. 3) DevEx: confirm shared links have external access controlled via signed links/SSO. 4) Ben: prepare pricing sheet with POC credit and 90-day promo, include usage caps. I'll compile and send procurement packet by Friday.

Clara - Solutions Eng: I'll also add a short appendix with verification tests we run (latency, token throughput, KV cache hit-rate). Need sample workload/profile from Peregrine — request that from Ben.

Ben (Sales): Got it. Peregrine contact is Emily (emily@peregrine.com). I'll ask for network diagram, HSM vendor/model, expected QPS, and sample prompt shapes. Will loop them in once we have the matrix and pricing.

Alice M.: Thanks team. If anything urgent pops up, ping me and @Clara for technical sign-off. :thumbsup:
